independent_retained_byte_audit.preflight_semantics: LDAPR is not classified as an invalid acquire; refusals reflect the stricter selected LDAR code-generation oracle.
independent_retained_byte_audit.scope: Bytes, exact receipts, source mutations, text assembly and public projection only; not semantic binary, weak-memory, signal or native proof.

limits: Authored synthetic library/models only: no SDK integration, trusted native owner admission, allocation/mapping, actual original/redirect or cleanup syscall.
Single-writer serialization, registry lifetime, unique instance identity and immutable module snapshots are external premises.
Full-blob admission is stronger than instruction-only attribution; later module envelopes may mask published records or own literal addresses.
Generation wrap refusal is source-reviewed only; no artificial exhaustion seam.
Nested harness calls are not signal interruption inside lookup; positive cross-thread visibility also has join synchronization.
Apple macOS host evidence is not Linux SDK/loader ABI, asynchronous signal safety, actual weak-memory/cache publication or binary/debug semantic equivalence.
No TSan, general race/lifetime, legacy volatile/module synchronization, native timing, persisted blame, quarantine recovery or fault-causation proof.
All native provenance/admission/current-ownership, writer/topology/stopped-recovery, Local Library activation/lifetime and stems staging gates remain CLOSED.
